# Samrat Parajuli (SamratVsn)

> Product-Minded Systems & Application Engineer in Kathmandu, Nepal. I build applications end to end — product brief → data model → interface → release. My deepest specialism is native Android with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.

- **Tagline:** I build applications end to end: product brief → data model → interface → release.

## Tech Stack

- **Languages:** Kotlin, Java, C, JavaScript
- **Android:** Jetpack Compose, Material 3, Navigation Compose, Room, DataStore
- **Architecture:** MVVM, Repository pattern, dependency injection (Hilt or manual containers, per project)
- **Async:** Coroutines, Flow, StateFlow
- **Web:** React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Router
- **Cloud & APIs:** Firebase (Auth, Firestore), REST APIs, Retrofit, kotlinx.serialization
- **Tooling:** Android Studio, Git/GitHub, Gradle

## Shipped & Published Work

- **[Avalokan](https://github.com/SamratVsn/Avalokan)** — Native Android heritage explorer for Nepal. Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Firebase Auth/Firestore, Room offline cache, Hilt, DataStore. Published v1.0.0 with a downloadable APK.
- **[Tasks](https://github.com/SamratVsn/Tasks)** — Local-first Android task manager with Pomodoro focus sessions, categories, reminders, and dynamic theming. Kotlin, Compose, Room 3, DataStore, manual AppContainer DI. Latest release: v2.1.0.
- **[The Movie App](https://github.com/SamratVsn/TheMovie)** — TMDB client in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose with debounced search, favorites, Firebase email/password auth, and disk/memory caching.
- **[BlogVsn](https://github.com/SamratVsn/BlogVsn)** — React 19 frontend for a Blogger-managed blog, with Google sign-in and a client-side EmailJS contact form. Deployed on Vercel.

## Additional Projects

- **[Kathmandu My-City](https://github.com/SamratVsn/Kathmandu)** — Material 3 recommendation app for Kathmandu's places, temples, shops, and destinations.
- **[Juice Tracker](https://github.com/SamratVsn/Juicetracker)** — Kotlin app exploring Compose/View interoperability with Room and StateFlow.
- **Student Management System** — Console CRUD program in C using binary file I/O and direct byte-offset navigation ([source](https://github.com/SamratVsn/C-codes)).
- **Bank Account Manager** — Kotlin CLI exercise in object-oriented account and transaction handling ([source](https://github.com/SamratVsn/Kotlin-Beginner-Codes/blob/main/bankAccountManagement.kt)).
- **[devPortfoli0](https://github.com/SamratVsn/devPortfoli0)** — This portfolio: React 19, Vite 7, Tailwind CSS 4, prerendered to static HTML.
